subject: Acceptance trigger for billing + PO details (Nimbus Health)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Carter <lcarter@nimbushealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff + invoicing expectations (NIM-2027-114)

Hi Leah / Procurement,

Thanks again for the productive conversation last week. Attached is the updated mutual action plan (redwood_map_v3.xlsx) and a short SOW summary that maps acceptance milestones to commercial milestones. High level asks from your side we heard: PO for Net60, billing address, and a single PO number per annual agreement.

Key points we want to confirm before we hand this to finance:
- Billing start: Redwood recommends billing to begin on the first invoice following production acceptance (acceptance = successful completion of the staged MAP acceptance checklist, see tab 3).
- Proration: If go-live/acceptance occurs mid-month we will prorate the first month and invoice on the next monthly cycle.
- Invoicing cadence: Monthly in arrears unless you require quarterly.
- PO fields required: PO number, legal entity name, billing address, remit-to info (we've attached vendor_w9.pdf), and a contact for remittance/questions.
- Payment terms: Net60 by default. We can accept Net30 for an early-payment discount (see section below).

Discount / ramp mechanics we propose in the MAP:
- Initial evaluation period: 30 days of platform credits for test workload (no invoicing while credits remain).
- Ramp tranche 1 (0-250k tokens/month): list price.
- Ramp tranche 2 (250k-1M tokens/month sustained for 30 days): 10% volume discount applied to the following invoice period.
- Commitment discount: if Nimbus commits to a 6-month minimum committed monthly spend, we can provide an additional 12% on committed usage and overage for the term.

Operational notes: if procurement prefers billing-on-signature instead of acceptance-based billing, the MAP will be annotated with an alternate trigger; billing will then commence on the first invoice after signature (no deferment during pilot). This materially affects the evaluation ramp timeline.

Happy to schedule a short call to walk through the MAP workbook.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0119
E: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_map_v3.xlsx, redwood_sow_summary.pdf, vendor_w9.pdf

From: Leah Carter <lcarter@nimbushealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nimbushealth.com>, Jake Olsen <jake.olsen@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + invoicing expectations (NIM-2027-114)

Tessa - thanks for the detailed MAP and the SOW highlights. Procurement reviewed and here are the key responses: 

1) Net60 is our org default; we will issue a PO with Net60 unless Finance approves Net30 for an early-payment proposal.
2) Billing trigger: Procurement prefers contract execution as a default, but we're open to an acceptance-trigger for pilots. Please provide the alternate clause text that explicitly states: 
   a) acceptance = completion of the MAP acceptance checklist;
   b) Redwood will not invoice prior to acceptance if acceptance-trigger is selected;
   c) in the case of acceptance disputes, Nimbus may raise acceptance exceptions within 30 days of acceptance.
3) PO fields: vendor legal name, EIN, remit-to address, billing contact, and the HubSpot deal id (we'll add to our PO line).
4) Invoicing cadence: monthly in arrears OK.
5) Credits: Confirm that evaluation credits are applied before any committed usage is billed (i.e., credits consume first).

Two outstanding questions from Finance: (i) if we select acceptance-based billing, do you allow a 30-day dispute window post-acceptance to raise billing/acceptance disputes? (ii) How do credits and committed spend interplay on the first two billing cycles?

If you can send a short redline for the acceptance-trigger clause and a one-page billing summary, procurement can issue the PO within 5 business days.

-Leah
Leah Carter
Senior Procurement Manager, Nimbus Health
lcarter@nimbushealth.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Carter <lcarter@nimbushealth.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + invoicing expectations (NIM-2027-114)

Leah 53 thanks for the quick review. A few clarifications and proposed contract language below.

1) Dispute window: Redwood is fine with a 30-day window to raise acceptance-related billing disputes after the acceptance date. Proposed language: 

   "Acceptance disputes: Customer shall have thirty (30) calendar days from the acceptance date to notify Redwood of any acceptance-related disputes. Redwood will suspend collection on invoiced amounts directly attributable to the disputed acceptance until the dispute is resolved, provided Customer provides reasonable supporting evidence. All other amounts not subject to the dispute remain payable pursuant to the payment terms."

2) Credits vs committed spend: Evaluation credits will be consumed first. Draft operational rule: 

   "Order of application: Promotional credits (including evaluation credits) will be applied to outstanding usage charges on the billing period(s) immediately following consumption. Committed usage is evaluated monthly; credits will offset usage before committed usage overage is invoiced. Any shortfall against committed minimums will be invoiced per the agreed schedule."

3) Acceptance-trigger clause (alternate):

   "Billing Trigger: For pilot evaluations, billing shall commence on the date of Customer acceptance as defined in the MAP acceptance checklist. If Customer elects contract-signature billing, billing shall commence on the date of contract execution. The executed Agreement shall indicate which billing trigger applies to the Order."

Operational ask: please confirm if Procurement needs the full SOW signed prior to PO issuance or if a PO referencing the draft SOW and MAP is sufficient to start the finance workflow. If PO can reference the deal & attach the MAP, we can proceed with DocuSign for final SOW within 7 business days.

Cc-ing Monica for onboarding/scoping so the MAP aligns to the rollout milestones.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
E: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
T: (415) 555-0127

From: Leah Carter <lcarter@nimbushealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nimbushealth.com>, Jake Olsen <jake.olsen@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + invoicing expectations (NIM-2027-114)

Rishi / Tessa - thanks, that language looks reasonable to Finance. A few final operational notes: 

- Procurement will issue a PO with Net60 referencing HubSpot deal NIM-2027-114 and attaching the MAP workbook. PO issuance target: EOD Friday (21 May) assuming Legal sign-off.
- We will select acceptance-triggered billing for the pilot. Please include the acceptance checklist (tab 3) in the DocuSign packet so Legal can review acceptance criteria inline.
- 30-day dispute window acknowledged. Finance will place any acceptance-related disputed amounts in review; other invoices remain due Net60.
- Credits: confirmed to apply before committed spend.

Next steps: Procurement will send the PO PDF to tessa_morgan@redwood.ai and copy finance-accounts@nimbushealth.com. Please send the DocuSign envelope with the SOW + MAP (acceptance checklist visible) so Legal can sign.

Appreciate the clarity 53 this should get us to PO quickly.

Thanks,
Leah
Leah Carter
Senior Procurement Manager, Nimbus Health
lcarter@nimbushealth.com

Attachments referenced: redwood_map_v3.xlsx (MAP workbook), redwood_sow_summary.pdf (SOW summary), vendor_w9.pdf (vendor remit info)
